columns.name: active_plan_guard

columns.name: administrative_closed_at
columns.rule: Fakta penutupan administratif historis; koreksi lama tidak menghapusnya

indexes: INDEX(patient_id,package_id,status), UNIQUE(active_plan_guard). Satu plan ACTIVE per pasien/paket. Booking pertama atomik membuat plan4 + appointment/billing/invoice sesi1; rollback tidak meninggalkan plan yatim. Retry key/payload sama mengembalikan asal; key bersaing ->409 TREATMENT_PLAN_EXISTS. Admin menjadwalkan sesi2-4 dengan lock plan, versi dan nomor unik; setelah plan terminal boleh booking plan baru, bukan extend. Urutan lock resource-hari -> plan -> appointment/request -> billing. Cancel/discontinue mengambil cakupan lock yang sama sebelum melepaskan tagihan bagian belum diberikan melalui adjustment dan menghentikan semua sisa appointment.

indexes: UNIQUE(booking_code), UNIQUE(plan_session_guard), UNIQUE(assessment_case_id,assessment_sequence); INDEX(psychologist_id,start_at,end_at,status), INDEX(patient_id,created_at). CHECK bukan case dan plan sekaligus; assessment fields semua null atau semuanya terisi. Jika plan null, session_number/plan_unit_released_at harus null; jika plan terisi, session_number wajib positif. plan_unit_released_at hanya diisi saat penutupan tanpa layanan dengan penerimaan bersih0, tidak saat appointment masih aktif. FK patient/package cocok case/plan diperiksa service.
checks: (assessment_case_id IS NULL OR treatment_plan_id IS NULL)

(assessment_case_id IS NULL AND assessment_role IS NULL AND assessment_sequence IS NULL) OR (assessment_case_id IS NOT NULL AND assessment_role IS NOT NULL AND assessment_sequence IS NOT NULL AND assessment_sequence > 0)
(treatment_plan_id IS NULL AND session_number IS NULL AND plan_unit_released_at IS NULL) OR (treatment_plan_id IS NOT NULL AND session_number IS NOT NULL AND session_number BETWEEN 1 AND 4)

(appointment_kind = 'STANDARD_SERVICE' AND package_version_id IS NOT NULL AND custom_label IS NULL AND custom_fee_amount IS NULL) OR (appointment_kind = 'CUSTOM' AND package_version_id IS NULL AND custom_label IS NOT NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(custom_label)) > 0 AND assessment_case_id IS NULL AND treatment_plan_id IS NULL AND owner_authorization_note IS NOT NULL)

(appointment_kind = 'CUSTOM' AND payment_requirement = 'REQUIRED' AND custom_fee_amount IS NOT NULL AND custom_fee_amount > 0) OR (appointment_kind = 'CUSTOM' AND payment_requirement <> 'REQUIRED' AND custom_fee_amount IS NULL) OR appointment_kind = 'STANDARD_SERVICE'
booking_source <> 'OWNER_EXTERNAL' OR owner_authorization_note IS NOT NULL
assessment_role IS NULL OR assessment_role IN ('TESTING', 'EVALUATION', 'FOLLOW_UP')

Draft penerus tidak mengganti jawaban efektif sampai submitted. Appointment membaca submitted yang ditautkan dan revisi sahnya, bukan pre-test terbaru pasien tanpa pembatasan appointment. PAPER tidak membuat submission kosong/flag SUBMITTED; dokumen kertas langsung ke Superadmin, tidak diunggah Admin dan tidak menjadi kolom answers pada appointment.

Reversal mengoreksi salah input, bukan menghilangkan uang nyata.

indexes: UNIQUE(reversal_of_id), INDEX(billing_account_id,received_at), INDEX(status,created_at). PENDING boleh status berubah via event; VERIFIED immutable termasuk amount/received_at. Koreksi: VERIFIED asal + VERIFIED REVERSAL minus + RECEIPT replacement positif, bukan mengubah asal lalu mengurangi lagi. Bila nilai benar0 (uang sebenarnya tidak diterima), buat reversal saja tanpa replacement/receipt0; ini koreksi fakta, bukan refund.
checks: status <> 'VERIFIED' OR (amount IS NOT NULL AND received_at IS NOT NULL AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND verified_by IS NOT NULL)
(entry_type = 'RECEIPT' AND reversal_of_id IS NULL) OR (entry_type = 'REVERSAL' AND reversal_of_id IS NOT NULL AND reason IS NOT NULL AND status = 'VERIFIED')
reversal_of_id IS NULL OR reversal_of_id <> id
